beats.text: A dating site turned off every photo. For one day.
On Love Is Blind Day, OkCupid hid all pictures for seven hours.
People answered first messages forty-four percent more often. And conversations went deeper.
Then, at four p.m., the photos came back.
Twenty-two hundred conversations had started blind. They just melted away.
Without a face, we were kinder. With one, we got picky.

sources: OkCupid (2014), 'We Experiment On Human Beings!' (Christian Rudder, OkTrends blog). Love Is Blind Day, Jan 15 2013: photos hidden 7 h; first messages answered 44% more often, conversations deeper, contact details exchanged faster; ~2,200 blind conversations melted away after photos returned at 4 PM. Via The Week / Marginal Revolution 2014.
